title: FETCH CHILD, FETCH ANY and FREE CHILD of RUN TRANSID children: COMPSTATUS, ABCODE, NOTFND and the invalid-token INVREQs

scenarios.summary: RUN TRANSID CHILD then FETCH CHILD: the parent waits, NORMAL with COMPSTATUS NORMAL and a blank ABCODE
FETCH CHILD of a child that abended: the FETCH itself is NORMAL, COMPSTATUS is ABEND and ABCODE is the child's code
FETCH ANY returns the one child's token; a second FETCH ANY finds no unfetched child: NOTFND with RESP2 1
FETCH ANY with no children is INVREQ RESP2 52; FETCH CHILD of a token never issued is INVREQ RESP2 50
FREE CHILD of a completed child is NORMAL; FREE CHILD and FETCH CHILD of the freed token are INVREQ RESP2 50
